name: VTC (Visibility-Aware Texture Consensus)
definition: A method that operates on explicit Gaussian representations to determine visibility and depth consistency at Gaussian granularity, down-weighting supervision using a fixed robust consensus target computed before training, rather than an uncertainty estimate updated online.
summary: VTC is a pre-training filtering mechanism for 3D Gaussian Splatting that rejects unreliable observations and uses a fixed color consensus to decouple geometry from appearance.
